description: Drafts a well-formed work item with testable acceptance criteria, then creates it in whatever tracker is connected, when the user asks for that explicitly. Applies the same standard to tighten an existing work item. Use when the user invokes /work-item, or asks to draft, write up, create, or fix up a ticket, issue, task, story, bug report, or sub-task, for Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Linear, or any other tracker. Use it even when the user names no tracker and never says "ticket", as in "log a bug for...", "file an issue about...", "write up a task for...", "can you create a story for...", and "this ticket has no acceptance criteria, can you add some". Do NOT use it for general prose writing, a PR description, or a commit message, because those follow different conventions.
